body.x: NEW YORK, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ''SCH-W210'' HSDPA S-DMB mobile phone during KES 2006. Users can have video call within HSDPA network area and if users go beyond the area, the mobile phone is automatically connected to CDMA2000 1x EV-DO(800MHz). It features 2.12-inch QVGA TFT-LCD, a 2M camera, a VGA sub camera, a microSD external memory card slot, VOD/MOD/MP3 playback, TV-out, ''my screen'', and black GUI.
